g.title: DIM
g.text: Solid arrow: association. Dashed arrow with open head: inheritance (inherits). Solid line with open head: as drawn in the original model (uses, includes).

g.title: Assessor
g.text: human source of information, e.g. diagnosis

g.title: Diagnosis
g.text: a diagnosis based on an evaluation

g.title: SubSession
g.text: session that groups specific configuration and data

g.title: EventMetricSensor
g.text: senses non-equidistant metrics, e.g. RR intervals

g.title: EquidistantMetricSensor
g.text: senses metrics in an equidistant way, e.g. speed

g.title: RawDataMeasurement
g.text: raw sensor data in physical units

g.title: MetricData
g.text: a performance metric derived from the sensor data
